cards.audioText: [Your call sign is ACA526, from Vancouver to Wuhan, you are cruising at 11000m over OBLIK, squawk 3555.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航526，从温哥华飞往武汉，你现在在11000米巡航，过OBLIK，应答机（编码）3555。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA526, 11000m over OBLIK, squawk 3555.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航526，（高度）11000米，过OBLIK，应答机（编码）3555。

cards.audioText: ACA526, Wuhan control, radar contact, reduce speed to Mach number decimal 75 due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，武汉区调，雷达识别，由于流量管控，速度减小至马赫数点75。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to Mach number decimal 75, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 速度减小至马赫数点75，加航526。

cards.audioText: ACA526, descend to and maintain 9200m, adjust speed less than 270 knots until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，下降并保持在9200米，调整速度低于270节直到进一步通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 9200m, adjust speed less than 270 knots until further advised, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持在9200米，调整速度低于270节直到进一步通知，加航526。

cards.audioText: [The TCAS indicating converging traffic at 2 o'clock position, below and climbing, confirm if it is a conflicting traffic.]
cards.audioTextZh: [TCAS显示汇入飞机在2点钟位置，下方，正在爬升。证实是否为冲突航空器]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA526, TCAS shows a converging traffic at 2 o'clock, confirm if it is conflict with us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航526，TCAS显示2点钟有汇入航空器，证实是否与我们冲突。

cards.audioText: ACA526, negative, that aircraft is climbing to 8900m, it will cross behind you shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，不是，航空器正爬升至8900米，它很快会在你后方穿过。

cards.audioText: [ATIS shows the visibility at Wuhan airport is low. You want to know if your alternate airport Changsha is available for diversion.]
cards.audioTextZh: [机场通播显示武汉机场的能见度很低，你想知道能否备降到长沙机场]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA526, ATIS shows the visibility at Wuhan airport is low, confirm if Changsha is available for diversion.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航526，机场通播显示武汉机场的能见度很低，证实能否备降到长沙。

cards.audioText:
ACA526 Changsha is available, confirm you are diverting to Changsha.
[Tell the controller you are not diverting to Changsha for the moment, you still want to fly to Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航526，长沙机场可用，确认你正在改航到长沙。
[告诉管制员你目前不改航到长沙，你依旧想飞往武汉]
cards.referenceText: Negative, we still want to fly to Wuhan, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不了，我们依旧希望飞往武汉，加航526。

cards.audioText: Roger, ACA526. Track direct to ZF, expect ZF-2A arrival runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，加航526，直飞ZF，预计ZF-2A进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to ZF, expect ZF-2A arrival runway 36R. ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ZF，预计ZF-2A进近，跑道36右，加航526。

cards.audioText: ACA526, descend to and maintain 4200m, maintain minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，下降并保持在4200米，保持最小光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200m, maintain minimum clean speed, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持在4200米，保持最小光洁速度，加航526。

cards.audioText: [Now you are established on ILS approach runway 36R. You are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你建立了ILS进近，跑道36右。你离接地点15海里，联系塔台]
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Tower, ACA526, established on ILS approach runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
注：建立航向道/ILS进近后，联系塔台即可。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航526，建立ILS进近，跑道36右，离接地点15海里。

cards.audioText: Roger. Surface wind calm. RVR touch down 550m, midpoint 600m, rollout 500m. continue approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，地面静风，接地点RVR550米，中间点600米，终止端500米，继续进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText:
Continue approach runway 36R, ACA526.
注：风和RVR值属于情报，无需复诵。

cards.audioText: [Now you are 10 miles from touchdown. Ask Wuhan Tower for cloud base.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你距离接地点10海里。询问武汉塔台云底高]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA526, 10 miles from touchdown, confirm the cloud base.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航526，离接地点10海里，证实云底高。

cards.audioText: Cloud broken 700m, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 多云700米，可以落地，跑道36右。

cards.audioText: [At the minimum, you are unable to see approach lights. You are carrying out a missed approach procedure. Advise Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在最低高度，你无法看到进近灯，你正在执行复飞程序，告知塔台]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA526, going around, approach lights not in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航526，没有看到进近灯，复飞了。

cards.audioText: Roger, follow the missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，按照标准复飞程序，可以时，告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the missed approach procedure, wilco, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照标准复飞程序，照办，加航526。

cards.audioText: [Now you are climbing to the missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Changsha Airport. Inform Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在爬升到复飞高度，你决定改航到长沙机场，告知塔台]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA526, we are climbing to the missed approach altitude, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航526，我们现在爬升到复飞高度，请求改航到长沙机场。

cards.audioText: Roger, turn right track to LKO, descend to and maintain 2400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，右转直飞LKO，下降并保持到2400米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right track to LKO, descend to and maintain 2400m, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞LKO，下降并保持到2400米，加航526。
